_doc: Sects the player can join. Alignment bounds are inclusive. min_realm is a realm id. cultivation_bonus multiplies qi gathering for members. Rank promotion is automatic once contribution reaches a rank's threshold. reputation (top level): standing with each sect, separate from alignment; start value, min/max range, leave_penalty (lost with a sect when you leave it), mission_rate (reputation per point of mission contribution with your own sect), tiers [{min, name, price_mult}] ascending by min (price_mult applies at merchants whose region place has that sect as 'faction'). Per-sect reputation: min_join (reputation needed to join) and deed_scale (a witnessed alignment change of D moves this sect's reputation by D * deed_scale; negative = the sect admires what others condemn). Effects can also change reputation directly with {"reputation": {sect_id: delta}}.

sects.name: Azure Cloud Sect
sects.description: An orthodox sect on misty peaks. Values virtue, discipline and the protection of mortals.

sects.name: Blood Lotus Sect
sects.description: A feared demonic sect. Strength is the only law; the weak are resources.

sects.name: Myriad Treasure Pavilion
sects.description: A merchant sect that trades with anyone who pays. Rewards craftsmen generously.
